---
title: "Multilayer Heterostructure Nanopores"
subtitle: "Material interfaces and molecular transport"
---

This project studies silicon nitride membranes combined with graphene, MoS₂, and hBN.

## Research question

How do layered materials and asymmetric pore geometry affect molecular transport?

## Approach

Electrical measurements and numerical modeling are used to examine relationships between pore geometry, electric fields, and directional protein transport.

## Research scope

The project connects membrane architecture with the interpretation of ionic-current signals. Quantitative results and device images will be linked after publication records and release permissions are reviewed.
